primitives.name: Usage Layer Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: **The week starts Monday, after the Sunday games, with USAGE.** Every team: who had upticks or downs in usage, script changes, role changes, whatever changed in the games just played.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'U_{t}^{T}': "Team T's usage vector at time t (dimensionless)", 'ΔU_{t}^{T}': 'Change in usage vector ΔU at time t (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Team behavior evolves deterministically with observed usage shifts; no exogenous shocks considered.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When ΔU_{t}^{T} = 0, the layer becomes static.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a discrete-time dynamical system updating team strategy vectors based on recent performance.
layer2.telemetry: Observable: change in player roles and play call frequency.

primitives.name: Matchup Layer Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Then MATCHUPS.** Player vs player, coach vs coach, scheme vs scheme, using the players the health layer says are actually playing.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'M_{ij}^{T_1,T_2}': 'Matchup strength between player i and j (dimensionless)', 'S_{T_1}^{scheme}': 'Scheme profile of team T1 (vector of tactical weights)'}
primitives.assumptions: Matchups are modeled as pairwise antagonistic interactions with fixed scheme profiles.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When M_{ij}^{T_1,T_2} = 0, no effective matchup exists.

layer2.mapping: Derived from player-level and scheme-level kernels, forming a composite interaction matrix.
layer2.telemetry: Observable: player performance differentials and scheme mismatches.

primitives.name: Situation Layer Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Then SITUATIONS.** The spot, the stakes, divisional familiarity, game slot, rest, schedule.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S_{spot}': 'Field position (yards)', 'S_{stake}': 'Game-theoretic weight of outcome (dimensionless)', 'S_{rest}': 'Rest period since last game (days)'}
primitives.assumptions: Situational variables modulate risk-reward trade-offs in decision space.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When S_{stake} = 0, situation has no strategic impact.

layer2.mapping: Combines positional, temporal, and contextual features into a scalar utility modifier.
layer2.telemetry: Observable: field position, game clock, and team fatigue metrics.
